baseline.label: stage0_raw_max_score
baseline.note: Stage 0 raw predictor scores only; not the legacy prior baseline (posteriors after heuristic priors)

metadata.note: Genomes without metadata are read as unknown: one unresolved block, never independent; adjusted intervals and permutation p are withheld when no peer has a resolved clade.

unplaced_proteins.note: Declared unplaced proteins are real proteins without a usable coordinate: family PRESENT, local context UNKNOWN (no window, no anchor, no coordinate invented). Family-search completeness (familySearchComplete) is independent of location completeness.

interpretation: Features for the learned stage, not evidence that a function is correct. A genome without peers retains available local/intrinsic features, with recurrence unavailable (not negative). Complementary-unannotated is an unsupported label, never evidence of loss.
